from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single university's CDS document."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the university as reported in the document")
    applicants_count: int = Field(description="Total first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")
    applicants_term: str = Field(description="The term/year the applicants data refers to")
    graduation_rate: float = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate as a percentage (e.g., 92.5 for 92.5%)")
    graduation_cohort: str = Field(description="The cohort year for the graduation rate (must be 2015 for the task)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
